name: model-openai-compat
description: OpenAI-compatible chat-completions adapter (offline slice). One bounded POST {baseURL}/chat/completions with response_format json_schema over the DraftAnswer blocks shape; usage from provider counts with estimator fallback. No tools field, no retries. Zero capabilities; https required except loopback http. Not wired into apps/server — live use needs the sources.md gate.
